strengths: Opening sequence (lights, soup, noren out) and taking it in while staff still clean is how small shops actually run.
Noren-wake as business vocabulary, not a visitor bow to cotton.
Faded noren as a tired awning is a local eye.

issues.location: When There Is No Noren — “Fire codes, HVAC” as the mall reason
issues.problem: Shopkeepers would more often say 見た目・チェーンのルール・邪魔. Fire code may be a factor in some buildings, not the everyday explanation.
issues.suggestion: Lead with corporate design and sightlines; mention building rules only as a maybe.
